card.text: Saturn's largest moon, the only moon with a substantial atmosphere.

introduction.text: Titan is larger than Mercury. Besides Earth, it is the only place known to have liquid on its surface, in methane and ethane lakes.

normal.title: Controlled infrared mosaic
normal.summary: Infrared light shows the surface through the haze, along with clouds and seams.

radar.title: RADAR global mosaic through T126
radar.summary: Brightness is radar backscatter, not elevation or visible color.

topography.title: GTDR measured heights
topography.summary: Cassini altimetry and SARtopo heights above a 2,575 km sphere, covering about 6% of Titan.

interpolated.title: GTDR interpolated topography
interpolated.summary: Heights interpolated between Cassini tracks; far from the tracks they are estimates. Compare Distance to data.

coverage-distance.title: GTDR distance to measurements
coverage-distance.summary: How far each point is from the nearest height measurement, in kilometres. It is not height uncertainty.

geology.title: Cassini global geomorphology
geology.summary: Dunes, plains, highlands and lake basins as interpreted from Cassini data.
